title: Crop filling: A pipeline for repairing memory clinic MRI corrupted by partial brain coverage
author: Leal, Whitfield, et al.

steps.title: Acquire paired MRI scans
steps.instruction: Obtain a T1‑weighted (T1w) and a T2‑weighted (T2w) MRI scan for each patient, both acquired on the same day.

steps.title: Zero‑pad partial T1w scan
steps.instruction: Apply zero‑padding to the partial‑coverage T1w scan so that its matrix matches the expected full‑brain dimensions.

steps.title: Match field of view
steps.instruction: Verify that the field of view (FOV) of the T1w and T2w scans covers the same physical volume.

steps.title: Register T2w to T1w
steps.instruction: Register the T2w scan to the T1w space using FreeSurfer’s mri_robust_register, following the SynthSR developer recommendations.

steps.title: Generate first synthetic T1w
steps.instruction: Run the SynthSR tool on the registered T2w scan to create a synthetic T1w image with 1 × 1 × 1 mm isotropic voxels and a 256 × 256 × 256 mm³ FOV, mimicking an MPRAGE contrast.

steps.title: Interpolate synthetic T1w
steps.instruction: Use FreeSurfer’s mri_convert to resample the synthetic T1w so its voxels occupy the same physical space as the original T1w, then trim any extra voxels so both images have identical matrix dimensions.

steps.title: Fill missing T1w voxels
steps.instruction: Replace the zero‑valued voxels (missing data) in the original T1w scan with the corresponding voxel values from the interpolated synthetic T1w, producing the first filled T1w image.

steps.title: Create final synthetic T1w
steps.instruction: Run SynthSR Hyperfine on the filled T1w together with the registered T2w to obtain a more accurate synthetic T1w, then repeat the interpolation (step 5) and filling (step 6) on this new synthetic image to generate the fully repaired T1w scan.

substeps.instruction: Run SynthSR Hyperfine with filled T1w and registered T2w.
Resample the new synthetic T1w with mri_convert to match original voxel grid.
Trim extraneous voxels to equal matrix size.
Replace zeroed voxels in the original T1w with values from the new synthetic image.
